paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama4 Scout (top) and Llama4 Maverick (bottom) on 5-digit multiplication.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the accuracy and initial confidence scores for two language models, Llama4 Scout and Llama4 Maverick, across a range of initial confidence levels. The x-axis, labeled “Initial Confidence,” is a linear scale ranging from 0.91 to 0.98 with evenly spaced tick intervals of 0.01. The y-axis, indicating “Accuracy,” extends from 0.60 to 1.00 with tick intervals of 0.05. Llama4 Scout is represented by a solid blue line with diamond markers, beginning at an accuracy of approximately 0.83 at an initial confidence of 0.91 and decreasing consistently to approximately 0.73 at an initial confidence of 0.98.  Llama4 Maverick is shown as a dashed orange line with square markers, starting at accuracy 0.92 at an initial confidence of 0.91 and decreasing to approximately 0.63 at an initial confidence of 0.98.  Llama4 Scout is also accompanied by blue error bars, extending from approximately -0.02 to 0.03, while Llama4 Maverick has orange error bars, ranging from approximately -0.05 to 0.04.  Llama4 Scout’s line exhibits a steady decline from its highest point at 0.83, while Llama4 Maverick’s line shows a steeper, more rapid decline throughout the interval.
